note: Names of medicines commonly given to babies, for the medication picker. NAMES ONLY: there are no doses, no frequencies and no schedules anywhere in this file, because this app never suggests a dose - a correct infant dose is weight- and age-dependent, changes as the child grows, and a wrong number on a screen is read as advice. Compiled from general knowledge of common infant medicines; NOT clinically reviewed, and not checked against a live source when it was written (the search tools returned HTTP 429 that session). Brands in brackets are examples of what a name is sold as and differ by country. Anything not listed can be typed in the sheet, and this family's own recurring names live in Settings, Medication presets.
